target: local Apple M4 (G16G), 10 GPU cores, macOS 26.6.2 (25G82), Metal 4
boundary: public Metal API only; runtime MSL compile of our own kernels (tools/shdump); dispatch+readback via tools/agxtest/agxtest.py+agxrun; every case a fresh process pair (run.py -> case_exec.py -> agxtest.py -> agxrun); no Apple binary, archive, BO, or command-stream inspection beyond our own compiled bytes
pinned_revision_note: authored blob hashes below are what gates validity, not live HEAD (SUBAGENT_BRIEF.md target-discipline rule; HEAD may move as the orchestrator commits sibling experiments)

items_partial_or_deferred.INT-08: best-effort register-pressure probe only; full 96-register independent-assembly proof blocked on the still-open register>=64 addressing question (docs/isa/register-move-and-liveness.md); see PRE_REGISTRATION.md
items_partial_or_deferred.INT-14: deferred; carry-generate operand-field layout not yet characterized well enough to safely splice an independent source without risking a misread silent-zero result; see PRE_REGISTRATION.md
items_partial_or_deferred.INT-09: COVERED but by derivation (31-clz) + structural re-confirmation, not direct primitive isolation via splice; see PRE_REGISTRATION.md
items_partial_or_deferred.INT-02/INT-11: COVERED at the compiler-contract tier (what Metal's compiler emits for extract_bits/insert_bits with runtime operands: ibfe/ibfins plus several helper instructions), NOT at the raw-instruction tier (whether the observed cnt==32 bypass is intrinsic to a bare ibfe/ibfins or added by the surrounding compiler-generated code) -- discovered post-freeze during analysis via tools/agx-isa tokenization, disclosed in RESULTS.md
items_partial_or_deferred.INT-12: COVERED for 10/16 canonical functions via a real, field-varying ilogic instruction; the other 6 (2 projections, 2 negations, 2 constants) route through different mnemonics (free passthrough / funary / mov_imm) in this compiler's output and were not tested against ilogic's raw field directly

capture.smoke_case: a+b uint kernel, NON-RECORDED, never written under raw/

raw_schema.00_env.json: environment/provenance receipt (informational git HEAD at capture time NEVER gated on -- pinned_revision above + authored_blob_sha256 are what matters)
raw_schema.01_results.jsonl: GATED, byte-compared-across-runs (see verify.py GATED_FIELDS): one JSON object per case with keys i,id,items,kernel,function,grid,status,pipeline_source,main_len,main_hash_sha256,main_hex,observed_sha256,observed_inline,compared -- no timestamp/duration/argv/stdout/stderr field
raw_schema.01_timing.jsonl: NON-GATED sibling: i,id,duration_ms,argv,stdout_tail,stderr_tail -- explicitly NOT required to match across runs
raw_schema.02_dispatch.json: run summary: n_cases, status_counts, results_sha256 (whole-file), code hashes
raw_schema.full/<case_id>.json: full per-element observed arrays for cases whose readback exceeds 200 elements (the two 65536-lane exhaustive PACK-04/06 cases); referenced by observed_full_ref in the matching 01_results.jsonl record
raw_schema.STOP.json: written on any pre-capture or capture-time stop; a run directory carrying this file is NOT a complete capture

authored_blob_sha256: see authored_hashes.json (30 files: analysis/, harness/, kernels/*.metal, verify.py) -- regenerate and diff against this file before trusting a capture if HEAD has moved. Regenerated once, post-pilot-run01-quarantine, to reflect a case_exec.py scratch-work-dir path fix (raw/m4-20260828T063741Z-run01/QUARANTINE.md) that changed no buffer/dispatch/oracle/comparison logic -- the officially promoted run01/run02 below were captured AFTER this regeneration, so this file matches what actually ran.
oracle_source: analysis/oracle.py -- pure Python, computed from NIR/GLSL/Metal-Shading-Language-Specification/IEEE754 PUBLIC definitions and exact rational (fractions.Fraction) arithmetic; NEVER derived from a GPU run. Cross-validated against Python's own struct 'e' (binary16) codec over tens of thousands of values (0 mismatches, PROGRESS.md) as an independent sanity check, not as the oracle's source of truth.
clean_room: OWN-SHADER + HW-PROBE + PUBLIC. Every byte executed is the compiled form of MSL we authored (kernels/*.metal, tools/shdump). No Apple binary introspected. tools/shdump, tools/agxtest are READ-ONLY (not modified). Public sources used for definitions only (NIR op semantics, GLSL/Metal Shading Language Specification pack/unpack contracts, IEEE754), never for Apple9-specific encoding facts, which are established solely by hardware execution + host oracle comparison.
